column1: The Group has five plants to manufacture its own products and three for contract manufacturing. In Andalusia, it has
three plants for its own manufacturing: two engaged in producing the active substance of low-molecular-weight heparins,
in Granada and Escúzar, and the new plant that will be producing sodium heparin. ROVI is, therefore, prepared for
production of a medicine like sodium heparin, which is classified as essential by the World Health Organisation and is,
moreover, among the medicines included in the European Union’s Critical Medicine Alliance, in which ROVI participates.
